Reader A adds POL-NS-06 as a concurrent route (dwell 80 s < 180 s). POL-NS-06 is not the deciding clause for a fee the rider's own cancellation triggered: POL-NS-10 is, by its notes, the only clause deciding such a fee, and reading NS-06 onto rider cancellations would contradict NS-10(f), which makes a post-grace rider cancellation chargeable whether or not the driver had arrived. The outcome is the same either way, so A's extra entry is a harmless reader addition; the key's list (POL-NS-10 alone, which licenses FULL_REFUND) is right and must not add NS-06.
